messages:
lin: ran an image hardening sweep on staging base: found world-writable /tmp, outdated openssl, and missing cosign signatures on a few tags.

amar: missing signatures are the biggest blocker for deploy gating. is it RBAC or bake skip?

lin: looks like RBAC: CI builder lost kms.cryptoSign for the cosign key after the role lock-down last sprint. bake still proceeds on failure.

devon: can we add a forced verify step in the bake job to fail fast? also need a migration plan for already-published images.

kevin: I made the RBAC change to reduce broad signing perms. I didn’t realize the bake uses the builder principal. I can add a scoped kms:sign for the cosign key.

amar: +1 to scoped fix. bake verify snippet suggestion: 

```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/cosign $IMAGE || (echo "unsigned" && exit 1)
```

lin: agree. devon, regarding migration: rebuild-and-repush is preferred for provenance. Re-signing layers in registry without rebuild loses build metadata.

devon: noted. also audit side: we only see kubelet start/stop; we need containerd pull events in audit stream for forensics.

amar: add containerd event forwarding in staging with a pull filter to avoid noise. sample config: 

```
containerd:
  enabled: true
  events: ["pull","create","start"]
filters:
  - event: pull
    fields: [image,registry,node]
```

kevin: will open RBAC PR with an expiry tag and rollback steps (remove binding via gcloud).

audit-bot: scan: staging/base-image:2026-11-02 failed 6 CIS checks. https://ci.internal/scans/2955550001

lin: thanks team. I'll schedule the base-image rebuild Thursday 01:00-03:00 PT (canary then prod). kevin, tag me on the RBAC PR for approval.

kevin: will do.
